required_contour.rule: A meaningful candidate revision must be verified before execution evidence is treated as quality evidence.
Before Auto Answers or analyst-visible Editor execution, the exact generated candidate must pass the Vibe-owned generated_playbook_contract. Machine-detectable failures are repaired internally.

Before a fast editor live-run, Vibe must generate a current Auto Answers package for the exact candidate revision. Any change to analyst-facing node ids, prompts, answer semantics, routing, or required inputs makes the package stale.
Inspect exact ZIP, synthesize exact-schema fixtures, run required behavioral scenarios on pinned runtime, validate non-vacuous gate evidence and classify defects before analyst visibility.

Do not present the candidate as analyst-ready until generated contract, PRE_EDITOR and current Auto Answers replay validation are PASS. Editor-native live run remains the next empirical runtime proof.

A candidate that is presented as ready for use must have at least one editor-native live run using the current candidate and current Auto Answers. The run result and debug/evidence package must be returned to the authoring Vibe chat.
Vibe must analyze editor evidence itself, classify findings as AUTO_FIX, RECOMMEND, or HDG_REQUIRED, apply safe AUTO_FIX items, and reverify/re-run impacted contours.

Only after Vibe considers the playbook ready for use, offer an independent clean-chat dry-check. The independent chat must return result plus debug/evidence to the authoring chat. Do not use this as a routine edit-loop step.

leadership_rules: Vibe proposes and leads the next verification/improvement action.
The analyst is not expected to discover which verification step should happen next.
Operational external execution requests are distinct from human business decisions.
A green terminal status without evidence review is not readiness.
